structured_output.tldr: Distribution strategy: one-command install via Claude Code, multiple fallback paths, zero telemetry, adoption metrics tied to first useful answer and 14-day retention.
structured_output.summary: The markdownattractor plugin uses a GitHub-hosted marketplace model with multiple distribution channels (self-hosted marketplace, GitHub Releases, Homebrew, cargo install) and prioritizes frictionless installation. Adoption success is measured by first useful answer within 10 minutes and daemon retention at 14 days, with design partner engagement every two weeks and diagnostics bundled in issue templates.

decisions: Distribution via repo-as-marketplace model with GitHub Releases, Homebrew, and cargo install fallback paths.
Adoption success defined as first useful answer within 10 minutes and daemon retention at 14 days.
Design partner check-ins occur every two weeks for the first two months post-launch.
No telemetry by design; diagnostics bundled in issue template and abandonment tracked in docs/aha.md.
action_items: Recruit 5–8 design partners with markdown-heavy repos before launch.
Create benchmarks page with 60-second demo GIF and plugin eval cases.
